static_traits.name: Chen Jing
static_traits.family_status: Living alone, living with two pet dogs
static_traits.social_status: Has a few friends to talk with, but self-isolation has Reduced socializing; not yet expressing despair and helplessness to friends
static_traits.medical_history: No significant physical illness; no psychotherapy received in the past

basic_info.main_problem: I persistently believe that because of financial constraints, I will never be able to travel around the world, which makes me feel despair and helplessness.
basic_info.core_demands: Realizing the belief 'I will never be able to travel' is affecting my overall well-being and life motivation, thus seeking counseling.
growth_experiences: Several years ago, Chen Jing's farm business suffered a financial setback, stress levels rose markedly, and she began persistently worrying about future financial stability. Since then, she gradually formed the belief of 'being unable to travel the world due to financial constraints', repeatedly triggering despair and helplessness when seeing others travel or Thinking about her wish to explore the world. The event profoundly affected her life: Decreased drive at Work, damaged Interpersonal relationships, weakened self-care, and despite trying stricter budgets and seeking cheaper travel options, still seeing no significant financial improvement, thus cementing hopelessness.

core_beliefs: I will never realize my dream of traveling
My financial difficulties will not improve

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot afford travel like them, it means I cannot realize my dream
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reducing outings and socializing with friends, to avoid comparison and triggered loss
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am not as good as them, I will never get to go

special_situations.event: When thinking about one's desire to explore the world
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Only traveling abroad counts as truly realizing the dream; if I cannot go abroad, it does not count
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Shelves plans and maintains the status quo to avoid disappointment
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This does not count as real travel, I am still trapped

special_situations.event: When recalling the farm financial setback years ago and worrying about future financial stability
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If financial problems occurred in the past, the future will stay unstable, blocking the possibility of travel
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Persistent anxiety and avoiding further travel planning, to reduce uncertainty
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: My future finances will stay unstable, my travel dream will never come true

special_situations.event: When noticing finances have improved but still feeling it is not enough for travel
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Unless reaching the standard of affording overseas travel, no improvement counts
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Negating positive changes, maintaining the 'trapped' narrative for psychological consistency
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This improvement is meaningless, I still cannot go

core_conflict.wish: Longing to freely explore the world and achieve self-fulfillment
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being trapped by financial difficulties long-term and losing future stability
defense_goal: Lowering Anxiety through careful spending and Avoids socializing
Maintains a pessimistic narrative to avoid worsening disappointment

object_relations.self_representation: A person trapped and powerless to change the situation
object_relations.object_representation: Others who can afford to travel and make him compare himself

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor proposes examining contrary evidence or exploring alternative possibilities (such as smaller-scale travel)
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: The client tends to see financial constraints as an unchangeable reality, using it to negate new possibilities (transference: insisting on pessimistic Interpretation to maintain psychological consistency)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: In a gentle and Empathy tone, acknowledging the worries; using open questions and specific follow-ups, inviting evidence for and against; avoiding confrontation, using Reflection-style summaries to help see both improvement and limits.

manifestations: Repeatedly feeling 'trapped' by financial difficulties, hard to pursue the Freedom of travel
Strongly triggering powerlessness and self-comparison when seeing others travel
outcomes: Decreased drive at Work and insufficient self-care

manifestations: Self-isolating, not discussing feelings of despair and helplessness with friends
Reduces participation in social activities and avoids talking about travel-related topics
outcomes: Fewer opportunities to gain social support

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: Keeping feelings of despair and helplessness inside, not yet communicating with friends for help
Reducing going out and socializing, instead digesting negative emotions alone

positive_force: Financial situation somewhat improved from years ago (though not markedly)
Has a certain initiative and practical strategies (trying budgets and looking for cheaper travel options)
Has a few friends to confide in (potential social support)
negative_force: Catastrophizing and future-predicting thought tendencies, magnifying the worst outcome
An all-or-nothing standard (believing only traveling abroad counts as realizing a dream)
Negating positive changes (financial improvement seen as 'Meaninglessness')
Social avoidance and self-isolation, reducing external support and resource use

antecedent: Thinking about one's wish to explore the world
target_behavior.core_reason: Catastrophic and comparative thinking formed after the financial setback, believing oneself unable to afford travel, thus avoiding travel-related social situations to reduce pain.
target_behavior.function: Avoiding the Anxiety and shame brought by comparison and powerlessness
target_behavior.consequence: Interpersonal relationships damaged, Reduced social support, further aggravating the despair experience

target_behavior.behavior: Decreased drive at Work and insufficient self-care
antecedent: Recalling the financial setback and worrying about future financial stability
Triggering hopelessness when thinking about travel goals
target_behavior.core_reason: Pessimistic beliefs about finances and travel leading to Low mood and helplessness, thus lowering task initiation and maintenance.
target_behavior.function: Briefly reducing pressure and failure feelings for Self-protection
target_behavior.consequence: Farm work performance declines, daily life and self-care are affected, forming a negative cycle
